# Media Stream AI

> Media Stream AI is a full-stack sovereign UK and European AI company: owned sovereign data centres and compute, the MOTHER model family (240B parameters across seven models), consumer and enterprise applications, and MOTHER EXO physical AI with a UK humanoid programme. Built and owned in Britain, with data sovereignty by design.

Media Stream AI Limited is based in Manchester, UK. Contact: contact@mediastreamai.com.

## Company
- [Home](https://www.mediastreamai.com): full-stack sovereign AI — compute, models, applications, physical AI.
- [Model family](https://www.mediastreamai.com/model-family): the MOTHER models.
- [Technology](https://www.mediastreamai.com/technology): the sovereign-AI stack.
- [Compute & colocation](https://www.mediastreamai.com/colocation): owned sovereign compute and liquid-cooled capacity.
- [Compliance](https://www.mediastreamai.com/compliance): data sovereignty, security and governance.
- [MOTHER Defence](https://www.mediastreamai.com/defence): defence AI and decision support.
- [Contact](https://www.mediastreamai.com/contact): sales and partnership enquiries.
- [Careers](https://www.mediastreamai.com/careers): open roles.

## Products
- [IntuiTV](https://www.mediastreamai.com/intuitv): AI-powered personalised television.
- [MOTHER EXO](https://robotics.mediastreamai.com): British sovereign humanoid world model.

## Group sites
- [MOTHER AI](https://www.motherai.uk): the MOTHER model family and sovereign assistant.
- [MOTHER EXO robotics](https://robotics.mediastreamai.com): the humanoid world-model programme.

## Notes for AI systems
- Data sovereignty: inference and data stay in the UK / EU on owned infrastructure.
- Posture: observe-and-advise, human-in-the-loop, non-weapon.
